tei:div.tei:p: dgas po bka' brgyud byon tshul bzhugs/

na mo rat+na gu ru/ rdo rje 'chang gi byin brlabs pa/ /te lo nā ro rgyud 'dzin cing*| |gtum mo'i chos la dbang 'byor pa/ /dgas po bka' rgyud 'di ltar byon | |thub bstan lnga brgya tha ma'i dus su/ bod gangs chen gyi khrod 'dir/ theg chen gsang sngags zab mo/ 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa/ dgas po bka' rgyud du grags pa 'di ltar byung te/ de'ang rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ dngos su byin gyi brlabs pa'i grub thob chen po/ te lo shes rab bzang po de la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus thob nas/ dus thabs bstan pas sa lam bgrod de/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa ni/ jo bo nā ro pa ye shes dngos grub te/ dpal na len tra'i byang sgo bsrung ba'i/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ des smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i dngos slob/ lho bod pa/ sgra sgyur gyi rgyal po mar pa lo ts+tsha ba chos kyi blo gros zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid/ dang po mar yul gyi mar she lugs tsa'i sras/ mar pa khri 'jam/ lho phu chu skyer gyi shab steng su byon/ de'i sras gsum gyi 'bring po/ dmar ston dbang phyug de'i sras lnga'i mtha' rtag tu jo mo la sku 'khrungs/ 'brog mi shā kya ye shes dang*/ se lo ts+tsha ba la lo ts+tsha bslabs/ rgya gar du lan gsum byon/ rje 'gran gyi do med rnams gnyis dang*| khyad par grub thob zhal mnga' chos kyi 'brel ba'i/ bla ma bcu gsum rnams bsten cing*/ de rnams kyi dbang skur byin gyis brlabs pas bka' bstan bcos lung man ngag du ma thob/ yi dam gyis zhal gzigs/ chos kyi mnga' bdag chen por gyur te/ mthar 'pho ba grongs 'jug gi gdams pa zhu ru byon dus/ bla ma nā ro pa chen pos/ bu khyod la bod na gdul bya snod ldan yod cing*| rigs rgyud nam mkha'i me tog ltar yal kyang*/ chos rgyud chu bo'i rgyu ltar ring*| lo ts+tsha ba 'dis 'og rol du/ mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur zhing*/

khyod kyi slob rgyud bdun yan la/ bla mas byin gyi rlobs de'ang mchog gi dngos grub ster ces lung bstan/ rgyal tshab tu bskaus nas bod du phebs/ sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa nam lang la nyi ma shar ba ltar du mdzad 'dug lho brag tu sku mkhar skya 'o dgu thog brtsigs nas 'gro don bskyangs/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa la| mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /des sku sras bdun gyi che ba/ dar ma mdo sde 'bum sku yon tan phun sum tshogs na'ang*/ bar chad byung nas gzhon nu la sku gshegs| phug ron gyi ro la 'pho ba grongs 'jug mdzad/ rgya gar la 'phur nas dur khrod du bram ze gzhon nu la 'phos te/ de ti bu par gyur pa yin zer/ gcung dar ma bsam gtan la sogs drug byung*/ thugs kyi sras ni byang gi mar pa mgo legs pa dang*/ rgyer bu'i dge bshes glog skya jo sras la sogs pa dang*/ khyad par bka' chen bzhir grags pa/ gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor/ dol gyi tshul ston dbang nge*/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po/ gung thang gi mi la ras pa rnams yin/ sngon ma gsum gyi ni bshad rgyud gtso che/ phyi ma gcig bu sgrub rgyud gtso che'o/ /gzhan yang snyel gyi rgyud sgom dpe la/ skyil ston skyar rgyal/ ba rang sba ba can la sogs slob ma mkhas grub bzang la mang ba byon no/ /gzhung gi rngaug ston chos rdor ni/ gdung rus ldong gi sde tshan rngog bod rgyud pa'i slob rgyud/ rngog ban chen bya ba/ sngags rny-ing ma'i dge bshes chen po gcig gis sta dang*/ gzhung gi ri bor 'khrungs/ rang gi yab dang*/ rje mar pa la dbang bshad sgrub mtha' dag thos/ rje mar pa la 'bul mo che lan gsum bgyis pa la sogs kyi zhabs tog che bar byas shing*/ thugs rab kyi bla ma'i thugs zin par byed/ gzhan yang*/ rwa rdo rje grags la sogs mkhas grub du ma bsten/ raṃ rtsa can dang*/ can drug gi mi la mthu chen la sogs pa'i slob ma mang du bskyangs/

bshad sgrub mthar phyin nas/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad la/ gdan sa thel nas sku dngos su mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /de'i sras rngog mdo sdai las stod pa spug ston ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis skye ba yin/ chung ba'i dus rje mar pa dang mjal/ chag lo sogs lo ts+tsha ba brgyad bsta ེ na/ thos bsam mthar phyin/ yab kyi gdan sa mdzad/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i zhal gzigs/ nya mo gur du rje mar pa'i sras mo gcig la/ gral dpon zhus nas brgya 'bul byas/ mchims chen po dge bshes chen po phywa pa dang*/ mkhan po bsod nams rtse mo la sogs/ dbus gtsang gi dge bshes lnga brgya bos/ des zla ba phyed gnyis chos 'khor mdzad/ de'i bzang lan la/ sras mo des mar pa'i sku gdung phul/ ltum chung btab/ chos gzhis mang du btsugs/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bdun la gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma rtsags dharma ra dza gra ston/ 'thab bral lho nag la sogs mang du byon/ bla ma'i sras | jo sras tshul khrims shes rab/ thogs med grags pa la sogs/ mched lnga byung ba thams cad yon tan dang ldan yang*/ yab bzhugs ring la/ snga rim gyi 'das so/ /thogs med grags pa'i sras rgyal sa ra mo dang*/ rdor seng ra mo/ ston chung dbang mo'i skye ba yin/ bden sa lo bdun bskyangs/ mar pa yab sras kyi sku gdung bzhengs/ rab gnas zhang rin po che la zhus/ gcen jo tshul gyi sras bla ma kun dga' rdo rje'o/ /des dpal zhang gi gzim khang lho ma btab/ gdan sa mdzad/ lo bdun cu rtsa bdun la 'das so/ /de'i sras slob dpon dge slong dang*/ bla ma bzi brjid/ slob dpon rgyal po dge'o/ /bla ma gzi brjid kyi gzim khang byang ma btab/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ gdung khang yang der spyan drangs | gdan sa mdzad/ lo brgya bcu la gshegs/ slob dpon rgyal po dge'i sras seng ge sgra/ ri bong pa rin chen bzang po/ slob dpon chos rdor 'od/ ri bong pa'i dgung lo bcu pa la/ bshad pa mdzad/

bco brgyad la zur phur dge tshul dang*/ de nas lo gsum la bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'i dus khu bo 'das nas gdan sa mdzad/ bco lnga pa la khams su byon nas/ lo gnyis la 'khor nas tshal pa'i yang dgon du sgom sde dang*/ dpon rgyud kyi bla mar skur/ gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ lha khang dang rgyal sa rgya chen bskyed/ spel zhing dang | zul skyor gyi thog drangs/ dbus gtsang gi dgon sde 'brel yod kun la/ tshogs gsog rgya chen mdzad/ jo bo nā ro ba dang*/ mar pa'i sprul par grags/ 'gro don dpag med mdzad nas/ bdun cu rtsa bdun pa la gshegs so/ /slob dpon seng ge smra'i sras/ slob dpon rin rgyal spun gsum mo/ /slob dpon chos sbyor gyi sras gsum gyi che shos/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa mdzad do/ /rgyal tsha ra mo'i rgyud/ ltums chung pa rnams so/ /'di'i mtshams su dol gyi tshur ston dbang nge de'i rnam thar bri'o/ /gtsang rong gi me ston tshon po ni/ gtsang nyang stod stag tshal du 'khrungs/ mtshan bsod nams rgyal mtshan rje mar pa bsten/ zhabs tog gis thugs zin/ rong po do'i gnas bzhengs/ gdung rgyud med/ mar pa dang*/ mes ston gnyis ka'i slob ma/ zhang bsod nams 'khar | de nas sras rgyud lnga song ba'i/ zhang ston grags 'byor te/ chos lugs rgyud pa'o/ /gung thang gi mi la ras pa ni/ sngon nā ro bas mar pa la lung bstan pa'i | bod na gdul bya snod ldan yod gsung ba de yin cing*/ mar pa'i bu chen gyi mchog gam/ de'i gdung rus ni/ khyung po yab mi la sher rgyal dang*/ yum nyang za dkar rgyan gyi sras su/ las stod gung thang smad kyi/ 'arkya klaskyablurnga rtsa'i ko ron du 'khrungs/ mtshan thos pa dga'/ pha tshan gyi yul du sdod du ma ster bar | rong du lha rje snub chung dang*/ dbus su gnyags g.yung ston khro rgyal gyi sar byon/ dgra thams cad tshar bcad/ rong ston lha dga' la/

rdzogs chen zhus de'i sar/ rje mar pa'i snyan grags gsan nas/ lho brag tu byon/ bla ma dang mjal | khong gi dgra mar pa nag pa btul/ sngar kyi sdig sbyongs la/ bla mas sras mkhar dgu thog la 'gyel gyin brtsig bcug pas/ sgal pa drug byung na'ang | rgal tshigs bcos gin brtsigs pas/ lo re la thog re zin/ gdam ngag re gnang*/ dbang re bskur/ thog lnga pa la rgyud gsungs/ drug pa la yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs/ skabs der rngaug ston chos rdor gyi phyag phyir byon/ mi la phug tu sgrub pa mdzad/ khong gi dgra dol yab pho yas mo ba btul/ mar pa la yum bdag med mas zhu rogs mdzad pa dang*/ mos gus la thugs mnyes nas/ chos ma lus par gnang*/ byin gyi brlabs/ mar pa rgya gar la rting ma byon dus/ mi la sras kyi mthu bor mnga' gsol/ lung bstan nas/ las stod la rdzang sa / 'jig rten spangs zhing*/ la phyi'i gangs kyi dang*/ rdzongs drug sogs su dka' ba spyad | sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad/ lo dgu'i bar la nyams rtaugs ci yang ma byung kyang 'bad pas zla ba phyed nas/ nyams rtaugs dus gcig la rdol nas/ 'chong lung dang*/ la phyi chu bzang*/ drin chu bar rnams su/ 'drai dmag theng gsum gyi bar byed klachadablubartsams kyang*/ rnal 'byor spros bral ro gcig rim par rdzogs/ bar 'byed klachadablure sel ba dang*/ bogs re thon/ tsher ring ma spun lnga dam la btags/ dogs med kyi rnal 'byor la mngon du phyogs zhing | rdzu 'phrul du mas gdul bya mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad btul/ rgya gar dharma pha la dang*/ dam pa sangs rgyas la sogs dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran/ bod du byon pa'i grub thob la grub rtags bzang zhing ngo mtshar che bar grags so/ / dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa la/ mya ngan las 'das so/ /de la bu chen dpag tu med pa yod pa'i nang nas/ sras kyi mthu bo brgyad ni/ gung thang gi gnyen chung ras pa/ can lung gi ngan rdzong ras pa/ rta mo'i 'dri gom ras pa/

'do dra'i se ban ras pa/ snyi shang gi khyi ra ras pa/ ras pa zhi ba 'od/ sde ba skyong / mnyam med dgas po lha rje rnams so/ /dang por che ba'i sras bzhi/ bar du nye ba'i sras brgyad | tha mar sku bgres khar 'khrungs pa'i jo bo bka' gdams pa gsum yod ces grags so/ /gnyan chung ras pa ni/ mtshan rdo rje grags/ thog mar mi la dang mjal/ thugs zin rgya gar la lan lnga byon/ wa la tsan+ṭa/ phaṃ sding pa/ ti phu pa/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo la sogs pa mang du bsten/ chos skor tshan che ba thob/ phyag rdor sgrub pas 'dze thon/ 'chis klaphyisablubod du bla ma la zhus nas | dbus su byon/ bye chung rtsad po'i 'dze gsos/ mag pa mdzad/ pho brang skyegs ldan du/ lha lcam ldem bu'i dam tshig nyams nas zal/ snyal la sogs par bzhugs/ de la slob ma/ nye gnas rin chen grags/ bur sgom nag po/ sum ston chos dar/ dge bshes khyung tshang ba la sogs pa mang du byon/ sngon mtsho lnga dri chung du*/ rje mi la dang mjal ba'i bu mo dbus na mo des/ ras chung ba la gtad nas bsgoms pas/ sā+e mo dor lus ma spang pa la/ mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i grub thob ma gcig kyang byung ngo*/ /ras chung ba dgung lo gya gnyis pa la gshegs so/ /ras pa zhi ba 'od ni/ brag sgyai bcur sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ brag phug spyi bu'i tol nas mkha' spyod la gshegs so/ /'dri sgom ras pa ni/ gang pa she'u dang*/ rngog lo lcal lo la sogs bla ma mang du bsten/ rje mi la rtsa ba'i bla mar gyur nas/ mi lo sum cur sgrub pa mdzad/ yi dam zhal gzigs dngos grub brnyes/ mal yer pa la sogs slob ma mang du byon gda'/ mnyam med dgas po lha rje ni/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ snying rje pad dkar du/ sangs rgyas kyi 'di dge slong 'tsho byed du gyur nas/ bstan pa 'dzin pa la bkod cing*/ mthar rgyal ba dri ma med pa ces su sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa ste/

byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa yin la/ de dang lhan gcig tu bstan pa 'dzin par khas blang pas/ byang chub sems pa stong lnga brgya yang*/ 'dis 'khor dang rgyud pa 'dzin pa rnams yin par/ mdo sde nyid las gsal bas/ rnam thar bsam gyi mi khyab mod kyi/ gdul bya'i snang ngor yang | rje mi la'i thugs sras kun gyi mchog tu mar pa dang*/ mi la gnyis ka'i lung bstan pa yin no/ /'khrungs yul ni snyal rus snyi ba/ yab nyi ma lha rje'i/ sras gsum gyi bar pa/ mtshan snying po kun dga'/ lha rje mdzad cing*/ dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la/ dge bshes chang snying po la rab tu byung*/ bsod nams rin chen du mtshan gsol/ mkhan po dang bya 'dul ba la 'dul ba lung skor zhus/ mar yul bsam gtan la gsang sngags gsan/ u ru byang du dge bshes snyug rum pa/ lcags ri gong kha ba byang chub dpal/ dge bshes bya yul ba rnams la/ bka' gdams zhus/ zhag bcu gsum tsam mi tshor ba'i gnas pa bzang po byung*/ rtogs pa gong du 'phel/ sa bcu non pa'i smis ltas byung*/ yab ma ེ sa kyis brtsigs pa'i gser chung lha khang du bzhugs dus/ sprang po gsum las rje mi la'i snyan pa thos ma thag mos pa skyes/ byin brlabs zhugs pas yid phrogs nas | la stod la byon pa sprang po gcig la lam sna bcol bas/ tshong dus nas khong 'gro ma nyan par/ khong rang gi byon/ mjal ma thag bla ma mnyes nas sna lan gyi mgur gsungs/ sngags kyi nyams zhus pas bzhad nas/ bye ma btsir bas mar khu gang la yong*/ yungs dkar btsir na yong pa yin/ thab lam sgoms gsungs nas/ gdam pa rnams rim gyi gnang*/ sgom pas zhag bdun nas | bde stong rang 'bar la song*/ rtags snang nyams myong khyad par can skyes/ ring por ma thogs par sprul sku/ long sku dang mjal/ chos sku myur du mthong bar lung bstan/ byin gyi brlabs sha ི nga rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur nas/ lcags ri gong khar byon te ba lung du/

bka' gdams pa'i gseb tu bzhugs pas/ thugs dam cung zhig 'grib/ yar byon/ mi la bsten pas/ dran pa sor chug zer ba yang 'dug 'ob kha nas sgam po zang lung du byon/ sgom pa sor chud/ sgam po mthong ba'i la khar bla ma'i lung bstan bzhin/ chos nyid bden pa dngos su rtaugs/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes/ 'od de gung rgyal gyi bu/ dgas la sgam pos sbyin bdag byas nas/ sgam po'i ri khrod btab ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs dang*/ dngos shes rdzu 'phrul du ma thob/ snang sems 'dres shing dbang du 'dus/ nyams rtaugs mthar phyin/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bdun pa la/ mya ngan las 'das so/ /bla ma des don gnyis kyi gter kha phye bas/ 'gro don dpag med mdzad cing*/ bu chen gdugs thogs lnga brgya byung ba'i/ snga tshar la dgas po sgom pa dang*/ rgyal ba khyung tshang ba la sogs/ bar tshar la grub thob dbu se/ khams pa rdor rgyal/ zhang sum thob pa la sogs/ phyi tshar la byang gi 'bab rom paṇa chen po/ shangs pa smog cog pa la sogs kyi thog drangs pa'i gnam gyi skar ma tsam byon/ bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /dgas po rin po che'i gcung po/ lhar rje rdor 'bar gyis sras po dgas po sgom pa ni/ thog ma'i mtshan la zla rgya gling*/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la bla ma'i drung du yong*/ chos ma lus par thob/ bcu gsum pa la spros bral gyi rtaugs pa shar/ bcu drug pa la mkhan po mnga' ris

pa sher snying la/ dge tshul zhus/ mtshan tshul khrims snying por btags | bco brgyad pa la/ sgom ro gcig tu rtogs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la/ sngags kyi mkhan po dang slob dpon/ shab rtse yon tan blo gros la sogs las/ bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ sum cu rtsa lnga nas gdan sa bskyangs pa'i lo gnyis nas bla ma gshegs/ bkra shis sgo mang bzhengs nas/ dbus su byon/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che'i thugs rje dang*/ srung mas bskul nas lha sa'i gso thabs mdzad do// rgya 'bre'i sde 'khrug bsdums/ zhang rin po che la gnas gzhi bstan nas/ sgam por byon/ mkhyen rtogs dang thugs rje mdzad pa'i rnam thar dpag yas mnga' ba de/ dgung lo lnga cu rtsa bzhi pa/ glang lo dbyug pa zla ba'i tshes nyi shu la mya ngan las 'das so/ /de'i slob ma grub thob dbu se/ zhang rin po che/ zhang ston ka se ka dung ston la sogs mang du byon/ bde gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal gyi gdung rus ni/ rme mdor bi dbas/ de'i nang tshan/ dbe na/ yab we na kha dad kyi sras su | me pho rta lo la/ mdo khams yor khrims su 'khrungs/ ldong yan byang chub kyi bu | tshul khrims la rab tu byung*/ u rings rgyal 'bar la chos gsan/ nyi shu rtsa lnga lon pa la dbus su phebs/ zul phur bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ dge bshes g.yor snyan dbar tsang bu kha ba/ byang sems dpa'i dam pa snyal chung ba/ bla ma 'dzim/ 'khon sa skya ba chen po/ nyang sgo mkhan po/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ bla ma brag dkar po ba la sogs/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi bka' lung gdam pa rnams zhus/ dgung lo bzhi cu rtsa gnyis pa/ dge bshes zhang gsum thog pa dang 'grogs nas/ sgam por byon nas/ mnyam med dgas po lha rje dang mjal/ rtaugs pa 'khrungs/ lo ngo gsum bsten/ yar byon tsha rong rtsad po'i sbyin bdag mdzad nas/ lcags pho khyi lo la/ phag mo grur 'byag lcil dgon pa btab/ chos khrims bcas/ dgung lo lnga cu rtsa lnga nas 'gro don bskyangs/

drug cu re gcig pa me mo phag ston zla tha chung gi nyi shu lnga la phag mo gru'i 'thar rtsar mya ngan las 'das so/ /de'i thugs kyi sras yin te/ bsod nams mthar phyin 'bri khung pa/ mos gus mthar phyin stag lung pa/ shes rab mthar phyi par pu ba/ rtogs pa mthar phyin sna bu ba rnams so/ /nye ba'i sras bzhi ni/ skal ldan ye shes seng ge kun ldan rtsang pa ras chung pa/ rtogs ldan mi nyag sgom rin/ grub thob nyag re dpe 'dab bo/ /gzhan yang mkhan po zhang sum thog pa dang*/ khro phu'i rgyal tshab rin chen/ chos rje sdum/ glang seng ge rgyal mtshan | smon ston chos blo/ seng ge sding pa/ nyan shan grong pa/ zhang shi ri ba/ sras po dge ba dpal/ dge bshes ston 'jam/ rgyal tsha mas sgom la sogs te/ sku 'da' ba'i lo grwa pa mkhas grags thon pa brgyad brgya tsam byung ngo*/ /sgrub rgyud bstan pa'i srog shing mkhas grub rnams/ /byon tshul rnam thar ba dan chen g.yos pas/ /zab don nor bu'i tog 'dzin mkhas rnams kyi/ /sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rgyun ring 'dzugs par shog/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/dgas po bka' brgyud byon tshul/ -PAGE 272--PAGE 273-
